aviation_incidents.headline: 路易斯安那州Cessna 210墜毀 飛行員受輕傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架Cessna 210於2026年10月13日在路易斯安那州Gonzales起飛後發生引擎脫離，隨後墜毀於Louisiana Regional Airport（REG）附近田地，機身最後倒置。AeroTime報導，74歲飛行員受輕傷。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Cessna 210 crashes in Louisiana after engine separates; pilot has minor injuries
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Cessna 210 crashed in a field near Louisiana Regional Airport (REG), in Gonzales, Louisiana, on October 13, 2026, shortly after takeoff. The airplane came to rest upside down. AeroTime reported that the 74-year-old pilot suffered minor injuries.

sources.name: AeroTime — Pilot survives Louisiana Cessna crash after engine falls off

aviation_incidents.headline: FAA推出MedGuide藥物查詢指南供飛行員與航管人員使用
aviation_incidents.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）推出線上指南MedGuide，協助美國飛行員與空中交通管制員查詢可使用的藥物，以及用藥後返回值勤前可能需要等待的時間。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: FAA launches searchable MedGuide for pilots and air traffic controllers
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has introduced MedGuide, an online tool for US pilots and air traffic controllers to check which medications they can take and how long they may need to wait before returning to duty. The searchable guide covers prescription and over-the-counter drugs, with waiting-period information after starting a medication or taking later doses.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 蔣萬安盼與中央合作推動松山機場遷建
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安列席行政院會，會前表示將在會中說明、討論松山機場遷建，並就整體評估交換意見。他也表示，願意與中央共同努力推動遷移目標；目前談及的是遷建議題與合作目標，並非已完成遷建。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an Seeks Cooperation on Songshan Airport Relocation
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an attended an Executive Yuan meeting and said before it that Songshan Airport relocation would be explained and discussed there, with views exchanged on an overall assessment. He also said he was willing to work with the central government to pursue the relocation goal. His remarks described a goal for discussion and cooperation, not a completed relocation.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中華航空更新輕旅行會員計畫，新增碳抵換點數回饋機制
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空股份有限公司表示，輕旅行會員計畫新增點數回饋機制。會員完成「環保旅程（Eco Travel）」碳抵換後，可獲得輕旅行點數；搭配其他挑戰項目累積達8點，即可享有購票優惠。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines adds points for Eco Travel offsets in updated program
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines said its Easy Travel membership program has added a points-reward mechanism. Members can earn Easy Travel points after completing a carbon offset through Eco Travel. When points accumulated with other challenge activities reach eight, members can receive ticket-purchase offers.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士預測2045年航空業人力需求達244萬人
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士在10月14日發布的《全球服務市場預測》中估計，全球航空業到2045年將需要244萬名工作人員。預測列出的需求包括66萬名飛行員、73萬名維修技術人員，以及105萬名客艙組員。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus forecasts aviation industry will need 2.44 million workers by 2045
international_aviation.summary_en: In its Global Services Forecast released on October 14, Airbus estimates the global aviation industry will need 2.44 million workers by 2045. The projected requirement includes 660,000 pilots, 730,000 maintenance technicians and 1.05 million cabin crew.

international_aviation.headline: King Khalid International Airport 逾八成離場航班受阻
international_aviation.summary: King Khalid International Airport（利雅德）10月15日預定處理366班離場航班，其中298班列為取消或未執飛，受影響比例為81.4%。
international_aviation.headline_en: King Khalid International Airport records 81.4% disrupted departures
international_aviation.summary_en: King Khalid International Airport was scheduled to handle 366 departing flights on 15 October. Cirium data cited by Aerospace Global News recorded 298 as cancelled or no-fly, a disruption rate of 81.4%.

international_aviation.headline: 法國空天軍於兩座民用機場操作Rafale與CN235
international_aviation.summary: French Air and Space Force在BASEX演習期間，於兩座民用機場操作三架Rafale戰機及兩架CASA CN235運輸機。演習於France各地自September 23至October 2, 2026舉行；部署地點為Pau Pyrénées Airport（PUF）與Dinard Airport（DNR），行動依據FRA-ACE進行。
international_aviation.headline_en: France’s Air and Space Force operates Rafale and CN235 aircraft from civilian airports
international_aviation.summary_en: The French Air and Space Force operated three Rafale fighters and two CASA CN235 transport aircraft from two civilian airports during BASEX. The exercise ran across France from September 23 to October 2, 2026. Deployments to Pau Pyrénées Airport (PUF) and Dinard Airport (DNR) were conducted under FRA-ACE, France’s adaptation of NATO’s Agile Combat Employment concept.

international_aviation.headline: 波音執行長將赴薩凡納與美國運輸部長討論認證改革
international_aviation.summary: AeroTime援引彭博報導，波音執行長 Kelly Ortberg 將於 2026 年 10 月 15 日在美國喬治亞州薩凡納，與美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 會面。RTX 的 Christopher Calio 及 GE Aerospace 的 Larry Culp 也將與會。與會者將討論如何簡化涉及航空器、零件及組件的認證流程。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing CEO to Discuss Certification Reform with U.S. Transportation Secretary
international_aviation.summary_en: AeroTime, citing Bloomberg, reports that Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg will meet U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy in Savannah, Georgia, on October 15, 2026. RTX’s Christopher Calio and GE Aerospace’s Larry Culp are also among the industry leaders who will meet. Participants will consider how the certification process involving aircraft, parts and components could be streamlined.

international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空將在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募活動
international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空將於2026年10月28日及29日在馬尼拉舉辦首次菲律賓飛行員招募巡迴說明會。公司於10月8日宣佈這項安排，並將與當地招募機構 Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc.（IPAMS）合作。第一天的場次安排在當地時間10時及13時，第二天則於當地時間10時舉行。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates to hold first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines
international_aviation.summary_en: Emirates will hold its first pilot recruitment roadshow in the Philippines on October 28 and 29, 2026. The airline announced the event on October 8 and is partnering with local recruitment agency Industrial Personnel and Management Services Inc. (IPAMS). Sessions are scheduled for 10:00 and 13:00 local time on October 28, and 10:00 local time on October 29.
